newsitem.title: USA: Medco optimistic on heart imaging agent.
newsitem.headline: Medco optimistic on heart imaging agent.

text.p: Medco Research Inc said Tuesday that results from the first human trials of Tc99m-GLUCARATE, its cardiac imaging agent under development, were encouraging, and that the company is looking forward to clinical trials in the U.S.

The results were presented during the proceedings of the Third International Conference on Nuclear Cardiology in Florence, Italy, and provided a preliminary indication of the agent's utility in providing an early and rapid diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction, said Medco.
Medco added that it plans to submit an IND submission in the U.S. within the next several weeks."
Medco is an emerging pharmaceutical company engaged in the global commercialization of cardiovascular medicines and adenosine-based products.
